claim: A double-buffered swap optimizer overlaps state transfers with optimizer computation by prefetching the next chunk from host memory and asynchronously writing back the updated chunk while a fused AdamW kernel updates the current chunk, removing most transfer latency from the critical path.
falsifier: On a system with optimizer state offloading, measure critical-path latency with and without double-buffered swap to verify latency removal.

conditions: optimizer state offloading to host memory
fused AdamW kernel updates current chunk
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported NPU system, optimizer (AdamW), and double-buffering implementation; transfer beyond these conditions is unestablished.

title: Double-buffered swap optimizer for removal of most transfer
